text: Idaṁ dukkhaṁ ariyasaccaṁ: jāti pi dukkhā, jarā pi dukkhā, maraṇaṁ pi dukkhaṁ.
gloss: This is the noble truth of suffering: birth, aging, death are suffering.

text: Sukho viveko tuṭṭhābhirato; passaddhakāyo sukhaṁ vindati.
gloss: Happy is solitude, joy in contentment; the calmed body experiences pleasure.

text: Tisso piṭakāya: vinayapiṭakaṁ, suttantapiṭakaṁ, abhidhammapiṭakaṁ.
gloss: There are three baskets: discipline, discourses, and the higher Dhamma.

text: Upāsakassa gehaṁ aggimā haṭṭhaṁ; sabbaṁ saṁharaṇīyaṁ bhasmāyitaṁ, so dukkhī mahā-dukkhi ahosi.
gloss: Fire seized the lay-follower's house; all keepsakes burned; he was deeply miserable.

text: Sāvako paṭipattiṁ puretvā thero vaṇṇaṁ labhi; tena pamodito pītisahagato cittaṁ.
gloss: The disciple completed the practice and won the elder's praise; glad, his mind was joined with rapture.

text: Idāni vassānaṁ pañcavīsati saṁvattanti; saṅgho Sāvatthiyaṁ viharati.
gloss: Now twenty-five rains have passed; the Sangha dwells at Sāvatthī.

text: Yaṁ sammukhā na labhituṁ sakkā, taṁ labhitvā ca puna naṭṭhaṁ — tassa duve dukkhā samudagamū.
gloss: What could not be found was found and again lost — for him two sorrows arose.

text: Mittaṁ cirarattaṁ na diṭṭhaṁ āgacchi; sammodamanīyā kathā vitisāretabbaṁ ahosi, mahā-somanassaṁ.
gloss: A long-unseen friend arrived; glad talk flowed, great delight.

text: Aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo: sammā-diṭṭhi ādi, sammā-samādhi pariyosānaṁ.
gloss: The eightfold path: right view first, right concentration last.

text: Ācariyo mama vāditaṁ nippatijāni; codetvā sabbesaṁ sammukha akkosati, mukhaṁ tassa paridevati.
gloss: The teacher denied my account; rebuked, he shouted in front of all, his face grieving.

text: Vassaṁvuṭṭho bhikkhu pasanna-mattikāy' odāta-vatthaṁ labhitvā upekkhako vasi.
gloss: The rains-finished monk, given clean white cloth, dwelt content.

text: Kammavācā pañcadhā vibhattā: apalokana, ñatti, anussāvana, adhiṭṭhāna upasampadā ca.
gloss: The proceedings text divides fivefold.

text: Duve puttā eka-dine byādhinā matā; pitā rodanto aṭṭhāsi, n'ev' attano na gehesu sati.
gloss: Two sons died of disease in one day; the father stood weeping, mindful of nothing.

text: Dānaṁ dinnaṁ vipākaṁ laddhaṁ: duggatānaṁ kulaṁ pattaṁ sugatīnaṁ padaṁ.
gloss: The gift bore fruit: the destitute clan attained the footing of the fortunate.

text: Uposathadivase bhikkhū sannipatanti; pātimokkhaṁ uddisati; pacchā vihāraṁ pacchimako rakkhati.
gloss: On the observance day the monks assemble; the Pātimokkha is recited; afterwards the last monk guards the hall.

text: Mahātalaṁ pabhijjitvā satasahassaṁ dhaññaṁ vinassi; sāmī vilapi: katamaṁ nu idānupāyo.
gloss: The great dam burst and a hundred thousand tons of grain were lost; the owner wailed: what remedy now?

text: Bhagavā etadavoca: katamañ ca, bhikkhave, sukhasmiṁ? Yadidaṁ nekkhammasukhaṁ pavivekasukhaṁ upasamasukhaṁ sambodhasukhaṁ.
gloss: The Blessed One said: what kinds of happiness? Renunciation, seclusion, calming, awakening.

text: Pañcavidho bandhasaṭṭhisaṅkhāto: khuddaka, mahā, ciraratta, padesa, sakala bandhānaṁ.
gloss: Fivefold enumeration of bonds: small, great, long-standing, partial, complete.

text: Sippikehi kuccavelāyaṁ kammaṁ nāṭṭhitaṁ; tesaṁ vetanaṁ na dinnā; te socanti kilamanti.
gloss: The artisans' work was ruined at the ill time; their wages unpaid; they sorrow and toil.

text: Thero paccavekkhitvā pamodati: khepeti me āsave; cittaṁ muduṁ sukhumaṁ aṭṭhāsi.
gloss: Reviewing, the elder rejoiced: my taints are ended; the mind abode gentle and fine.

text: Vatthusādanā paṭhamā, dānakathā dutiyā, sīlakathā tatiyā, saggakathā catutthā.
gloss: First the talk on merit-making, then giving, then virtue, then heaven.

text: Amittā senā santhambhitvā gamakaṁ dahesuṁ; vassātivassānaṁ laddhaṁ sabbanamamāgataṁ.
gloss: The opposing army burned the hamlet; the gains of many rains all came to nothing.

text: Sappuruho nāma: sakkaccaṁ dhammaṁ suṇāti; sutvā muducitto hoti; tena pamādo na upaṭṭhāti.
gloss: The good person listens respectfully; hearing, his mind softens; heedlessness does not arise.

text: Tayo puñña-kiriyavatthū: dānamayaṁ, sīlamayaṁ, bhāvanāmayaṁ.
gloss: Three bases of meritorious action: giving, virtue, cultivation.

text: Dārikaṁ uyyānantaraṁ gatā na paṭigacche; mātā tālaṁ paharitvā paridevesi, janakulā sussosiṁsu.
gloss: The girl went into the park and did not come back; the mother beat the ground lamenting, the crowds heard.

text: Upāsikā bhikkhusaṅghassa bhattaṁ deti; bhattaggaṁ pasannā dakkhiṇaṁ patvā attamanā hosi.
gloss: The laywoman gives almsfood to the Sangha; pleased at the meal-hall she was delighted.

text: Pañca khandhā: rūpakhandho, vedanākhandho, saññākhandho, saṅkhārakkhandho, viññāṇakkhandho.
gloss: Five aggregates: form, feeling, perception, formations, consciousness.

text: Pabhātāya rattiyā yānaṁ vippahīnaṁ appaṭikūlaṁ; yāturāṇaṁ nāsikāya kaṇhasappaṁ daṭṭhā.
gloss: At dawn the chariot was crippled beyond repair; a black serpent bit the traveller.

text: Samaṇo pabbajito cirakālaṁ virato; sāmiko disvā vaṇṇaṁ bhāsittha; tena so pītisahagato viharati.
gloss: The long-abstinent wanderer was praised by the householder; he dwells joy-filled.

text: Cha dhātuyo: pathavī, āpo, tejo, vāyo, ākāsa, viññāṇaṁ.
gloss: Six elements: earth, water, fire, air, space, consciousness.

text: Mahāvane corā santāsetvā dhanuṃ hariṁsu; kulagehaṁ suññaṁ; tato uccena dukkhaṁ uppajji.
gloss: Thieves in the great grove stole the bow/wealth; the family house emptied; great suffering arose.

text: Satthā anumodi: sādhu bhikkhu, sādhu bhikkhu 'ti; ṭhānaṁ so laddhaṁ, saṅgho mudito.
gloss: The Teacher commended: good, monk, good; he gained standing, the Sangha rejoiced.

text: Aṭṭhārasake bhāsā vicitrayuttikā: mūla, vañjha, sandhi, opamma paṭisandhi ca.
gloss: Eighteen grammatical categories, beginning with root and metaphor.

text: Tikavippattiyā dakkhaṁ kammaṁ parikkhīṇaṁ; ācariyo kujjhitvā antevāsikaṁ pabbājesi.
gloss: By threefold failure the skilled work went to waste; the angry teacher expelled the pupil.

text: Sikkhā-padaṁ puretvā antevāsikā therassa padakkhīṇaṁ akaṁsu; tena somanassaṁ jātaṁ.
gloss: Having completed the training the pupils circumambulated the elder; joy arose thereby.

text: Dvāsaṭṭhi diṭṭhiyā pakāsitā Brahmajāle; atthānaṁ ca nivaritaṁ.
gloss: Sixty-two views expounded in the Brahmajāla; and refuted.

text: Āpo gaṅgāya ubbandhitvā gāmaṁ nimmadayaṁsu; jano aḷāraṁ bandhitvā pabbatā gato; tato nu dukkhaṁ.
gloss: The Ganges waters rose and crushed the village; the people tied rafts and fled to the hills; there was suffering.

text: Sakkāro cattāro: cīvara, piṇḍapāta, senāsana, bhesajjaṁ; laddho so upāsakena pasīditvā dinno.
gloss: The four requisites: robe, almsfood, lodging, medicine — given by a pleased lay follower.

text: Satta bodhaṅge: sati, dhammavicayo, vīriyaṁ, pīti, passaddhi, samādhi, upekkhā.
gloss: Seven awakening factors: mindfulness, investigation, energy, rapture, calm, concentration, equanimity.

text: Rattandhakāre kumaṇaṁ aññatarena sappena daṭṭhaṁ; vejjo na labhi; dārako kālamakāsi.
gloss: In the dark of night the boy was bitten by a serpent; no doctor was found; the boy died.
